simple.meaning: חֵפֶר (Chêpher) appears 9 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Numbers, Joshua, 1 Kings, 1 Chronicles, beginning at Numbers 26:32. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship, land.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows חֵפֶר through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: Chepher , a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H2660. Chepher I. חֵ֫פֶר proper name, masculine 1. a Manassite Num 26:32-33 , 27:1 ; Josh 17:2-3 , ᵐ5 Οφερ . 2 a man of Judah 1Chr 4:6 ; ᵐ5 Ηφαλ , ᵐ5 L Αφερ . 3 one of David's heroes , according to 1Chr 11:36 (but on text see Be VB and Dr 2Sam 23:36 ). II. חֵ֫פֶר proper name, of a location 1. Canaanitish town, with a king, named just before Aphek Josh 12:17 , exact site unknown. 2 1Kin 4:10 in Judah ( ח ׳ארץ ); — on ח ׳גִּ֫תָּה Josh 19:13 , הַח ׳גַּת 2Kin 14:25 , see גַּת below יגן .
